classification.difficultyReason: Interpret the flat and sloping pool floor and combine rectangular and triangular prism volumes.

content.prompt: Calculate the volume of earth that must be excavated so that the pool shell below fits exactly into the hole.

spec.description: Pool excavation with a flat 5 m deep-end floor followed by a 25 m sloping floor. Rear and concealed floor edges are dashed; external arrows identify all measurements.
spec.mathematics: Length 30 m, width 10 m, deep depth 2.4 m, shallow depth 1.2 m, flat deep-end length 5 m.

answer.worked:
Split the excavation into a rectangular prism of depth $1.2\ \mathrm{m}$, an additional deep-end rectangular prism and a triangular prism beneath the sloping floor.
$\begin{align*}V_1&=30\times10\times1.2=360\ \mathrm{m}^3\\V_2&=5\times10\times(2.4-1.2)=60\ \mathrm{m}^3\\V_3&=\frac12\times(30-5)\times(2.4-1.2)\times10\\V_3&=150\ \mathrm{m}^3\\V_{\mathrm{tot}}&=360+60+150\\V_{\mathrm{tot}}&=570\ \mathrm{m}^3\end{align*}$
